grammar.summary: 本课以可爱的怪人迪基为主线，重点运用了 Though 让步状语从句、分词短语作状语以及 it 作形式主语的结构。体会作者如何用 Though 让步于「有车却爱步行」、用分词短语描写迪基淋雨后进店与认出顾客的动作、用 it 使「花四年策划闹剧」的重心后移。

points.title: Though 让步状语从句 (Concessive Clause)
points.explanation: though 引导让步状语从句，表示「尽管……」。本课用 Though he owned a large car 让步于「虽有豪华轿车」，随即点出迪基「却很少使用、爱以步代车」，凸显其怪癖。

examples.en: Though he owned a large car, he hardly ever used it, preferring always to go on foot.
examples.cn: 尽管他有一辆豪华小轿车，但却很少使用，常常喜欢以步代车。

points.title: 分词短语作状语 (Participle Phrase as Adverbial)
points.explanation: 现在分词短语可作伴随状语，逻辑主语与句子主语一致。本课用 after having been caught in a particularly heavy shower（完成式分词，表先于主句的动作）、Recognizing who the customer was 描写迪基淋雨进店与经理认出顾客的情景，使叙事生动。

examples.en: One day, he walked into an expensive shop after having been caught in a particularly heavy shower.
examples.cn: 一天，他遇上一场瓢泼大雨，淋得透湿，他走进一家高级商店。

examples.en: Recognizing who the customer was, the manager was most apologetic and reprimanded the assistant severely.
examples.cn: 经理认出了这位顾客，表示了深深的歉意，还严厉地训斥了店员。

points.title: it 作形式主语 (Preparatory it)
points.explanation: it 可作形式主语，代替后面真正的主语（不定式/从句），使长句重心后移、结构平衡。本课用 It took him four years to stage this elaborate joke，it 代 to stage this elaborate joke，强调「花了四年才策划这出闹剧」。

examples.en: It took him four years to stage this elaborate joke simply to prove that critics do not always know what they are talking about.
examples.cn: 他花了4年时间策划这出精心设计的闹剧，只是想证明评论家们有时并不解他们所谈论的事情。

exercises.q: ______ he owned a large car, he hardly ever used it, preferring always to go on foot.
______ who the customer was, the manager was most apologetic and reprimanded the assistant severely.（用分词作状语）
______ took him four years to stage this elaborate joke simply to prove that critics do not always know what they are talking about.（用形式主语）
用动词的适当形式填空：True eccentrics never deliberately set out to draw attention to themselves. They disregard social conventions without ______ (be) conscious that they are doing anything extraordinary.
